verdict.rationale: The evidence shows high-volume raw event export, warehouse sync and GDPR deletion/retrieval APIs. These are export, import and privacy capabilities, not documented bulk operations such as batch edit, delete or update across many items at once. Bulk export maps to a separate data-export story and does not transfer here, so no direct evidence supports bulk actions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
